claims.text: RFC 7626 describes privacy issues of DNS use by Internet users
claims.quote: This document describes the privacy issues associated with the use of the DNS by Internet users.

claims.text: DoT: TLS removes eavesdropping and on-path tampering with DNS queries
claims.quote: Encryption provided by TLS eliminates opportunities for eavesdropping and on-path tampering with DNS queries in the network

claims.text: DoH sends DNS queries and responses over HTTPS
claims.quote: This document defines a protocol for sending DNS queries and getting DNS responses over HTTPS.
By default, a DNS server that supports DNS over TLS MUST listen for and accept TCP connections on port 853

claims.text: DoH uses HTTPS and the DNS message media type
claims.quote: Each DNS query-response pair is mapped into an HTTP exchange.
